title: How We're Organised
subtitle: Departments and how they work together

sources.label: J&J MedTech shifts to a business-unit-led operating model (MassDevice)

cards.title: A business-unit-led organisation
cards.body: Since January 2026 J&J MedTech runs on a business-unit-led operating model worldwide. Business units own their strategy and results end to end, which cuts layers of approval and helps teams move faster for customers and patients.

cards.title: From idea to patient
cards.body:
Every product travels the same journey. Watch the glowing token in the 3D scene: it moves from research and development, through quality, clinical and regulatory work, into manufacturing and supply, and finally to the teams who support clinicians and patients.

Support functions – such as Finance, HR, Technology, Legal & Compliance and EHS – make that journey possible.

cards.title: Where do you fit?
cards.body: Your manager will show you your team's place on this map. The local organisation chart of our site is in the Our Site station – ask your onboarding buddy to walk you through it.

operatingModel: Business units lead; functions partner with them. You will often work in cross-functional teams that bring several departments together around one product or project.

functions.name: Research & Development
functions.role: Turns unmet clinical needs into new products – from first concept to a verified design.
functions.workWith: Clinicians, Quality and Regulatory from day one of every project.

functions.name: Quality
functions.role: Makes sure every product is safe and effective, and that we follow our quality system and regulations.
functions.workWith: Every department – quality is everyone's responsibility.

functions.name: Clinical & Medical Affairs
functions.role: Generates clinical evidence and medical expertise, and runs clinical studies.
functions.workWith: R&D to design studies, Regulatory to submit evidence.

functions.name: Regulatory Affairs
functions.role: Plans the path to market and obtains approvals from authorities such as the FDA and EU notified bodies.
functions.workWith: R&D, Clinical and Quality on submissions.

functions.name: Operations & Supply Chain
functions.role: Manufactures products at the right quality and cost, and delivers them to hospitals on time.
functions.workWith: Quality every day; R&D when new products are transferred to production.

functions.name: Commercial
functions.role: Brings products to clinicians: marketing, sales, professional education and customer support.
functions.workWith: Clinical for evidence, Operations for supply.

functions.name: Finance
functions.role: Plans budgets, tracks performance and supports investment decisions.
functions.workWith: Every business unit leader and project.

functions.name: Human Resources
functions.role: Hires, develops and supports our people – including your onboarding.
functions.workWith: You and your manager throughout your career.

functions.name: Technology (IT & Digital)
functions.role: Provides secure systems, data and digital tools – and protects them from cyber threats.
functions.workWith: Everyone – contact the service desk for access and equipment.

functions.name: Legal & Compliance
functions.role: Protects the company and helps us act with integrity: contracts, privacy, anti-corruption and healthcare compliance.
functions.workWith: Commercial and anyone interacting with healthcare professionals.

functions.name: Environment, Health & Safety
functions.role: Keeps people safe at work and protects the environment.
functions.workWith: Everyone on site – especially labs and production.
